mapper.sql: select menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, `query`, route_name, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, ifnull(perms,'') as perms, ifnull(client_type, 'admin') as client_type, icon, create_time from sys_menu
mapper.select: select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, ifnull(m.client_type, 'admin') as client_type, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 and m.is_delete = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, ifnull(m.client_type, 'admin') as client_type, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id and ur.is_delete = 0 left join sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.role_id and ro.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id and u.is_delete = 0 where u.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 and m.is_delete = 0 and ro.status = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select m.menu_id from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_delete = 0 where rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.is_delete = 0
and m.menu_id not in (select m.parent_id from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.role_id = #{roleId} and rm.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0)
order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id and ur.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id and ur.is_delete = 0 left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.is_delete = 0 where m.status = '0' and r.status = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.is_delete = 0 and (m.client_type = #{clientType} or m.client_type = 'all')

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.is_delete = 0 where m.status = '0' and rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.is_delete = 0 and (m.client_type = #{clientType} or m.client_type = 'all')
select count(1) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{menuId} and is_delete = 0
where menu_name= #{menuName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
where menu_type in ('M', 'C') and is_delete = 0 and (path = #{path} or path = #{routeName} or route_name = #{path} or route_name = #{routeName})

where menu_id = #{menuId} and is_delete = 0
